asks.description: Questions a caller asks that this section answers, in their words ("how much is a generic drug" for a table's row that says Tier 1). Retrieval reads them beside the section's own text; they are never said, so a document's approval does not cover them.

keywords.description: Words and phrases that name what the section answers exactly. Retrieval matches them as phrases.

additionalProperties.description: How a section of a document is found: what retrieval reads beside its own text.

description: kb/sections.yaml: how the sections of documents approved for summarizing are found (kb.yaml documents), by section: the questions callers ask that each answers, and its keywords. Retrieval reads them; they are never said, so a document's approval does not cover them and editing them needs none.
title: DialogWright kb/sections.yaml
